verdict.rationale: GitLab's Duo Agent Platform lets users build custom flows that automate team processes [gitlab-docs-36] and define triggers controlling when they run [gitlab-docs-59]. Users can delegate routine tasks to agents [gitlab-docs-47], and agents turn issues into merge requests and remediate vulnerabilities [gitlab-docs-1]. Sessions report the status and execution data of runs [gitlab-docs-37], and agent actions are attributed to a service account for auditing [gitlab-docs-62]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of background or scheduled execution without a user present, detail on the available trigger types, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous runs.
